Question: Premise: There was a book I was trying to import and I saw that it was finally available with Amazon Prime shipping and I ended up paying like double the other prices to have it in 2 days vs. 2 weeks., Hypothesis: I waited until Prime availability and paid a higher Shipping & Handling fee to have a book in 2 days vs. 2 weeks.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct choice.
